title: 15 October 1962: Live: Oasis Club, Manchester
content:
The Beatles’ second show at the Oasis Club on 45-47 Lloyd Street, Manchester, was also their second in the city.

The group performed four times at the Oasis Club. The other dates were 2 February and 8 December 1962, and 22 February 1963.

The building, which stood at 45-47 Lloyd Street, was redeveloped in the 1990s and no longer exists in the same form.
